title: Relative approximation degrees and the henselian rationality problem over perfect fields
summary: Let $(F|K,w)$ be an immediate valued function field of transcendence degree one over a rank-one perfect valued field $(K,v)$ of characteristic $p>0$. It is henselian rational if $F^h=K(Y)^h$ for some $Y\in F^h$. Kuhlmann proved henselian rationality over tame fields; we investigate how far his method extends to perfect fields. Relative approximation degrees are a central ingredient in Kuhlmann's approach.
